sources.title: Cresswell Plaza — project management and marketing portfolio identity
sources.note: Merath portfolio and DLD authority identify the same uniquely named 35-unit residential project. DLD developer contact and the Merath public footer share a business domain. Merath service roles remain separate from legal developer identity. Area figures have undefined and unreconciled bases; neither is used for valuation. Future-dated DLD inspection remains quarantined. No completion, occupancy or corporate ownership relationship inferred.

facts.identityBasis: Unique non-archived Cresswell Plaza catalogue record in Dubai South. Merath's primary portfolio identifies Cresswell Plaza as a 35-unit residential project with project-management, sales and marketing services. DLD public status identifies project 4359, 35 residential units, Madinat Al Mataar and legal developer Essa Bokhowa Properties L.L.C, number 2475; the downloadable developer register confirms ID 804324850. The DLD developer contact and Merath public footer share the merathmanagement.com business domain. These are separate organizational roles, not corporate aliases. Only Residential/Unit/Flat sale registrations with exact project number 4359, area 462, project name and building Cresswell Plaza are included. Cresswell Views, Residence and Homes are distinct projects. Commercial, land, gifts and mortgages are excluded. Future-dated inspection and generic coordinates are not used; area-definition conflict remains unresolved.

observation.observationDateBasis: DLD instance_date registration day; not first-ever sale, contract execution or current valuation
